بَارِدُونَ: cold (plural for people; wrong here — correct: bārida)
طَبَقَانِ: two dishes (wrong as an object — correct: ṭabaqayni)
يَزُورُونَ: they visit (wrong before a plural subject — correct: yazūru)
أَجِدُهَا: I find it (wrong after lam — correct: ajidhā)
لِأَدْعُو: to invite (wrong here — correct: li-adʿuwaka, to invite you)
أَجْلِسُ: I sit (wrong after an — correct: ajlisa)
جَوَازِي: my permit (wrong here — correct: jawāzu safarī)
تُوقِظُنَا: you wake us (wrong after an — correct: tūqiẓanā)
لِلَيْلَتَانِ: for two nights (wrong after li — correct: li-laylatayni)
نَزُورْهَا: we visit it (wrong after lam — correct: nazurhā)
الْأَشْهَرُ: the most famous (wrong before a noun — correct: ashharu)
أَتَّصِلُكَ: I call you (wrong — correct: attaṣilu bika)
الْأَخْبَارِ: the news (wrong ending after inna — correct: al-akhbāra)
الْمِفْتَاحُ: the key (wrong in an iḍāfa — correct: miftāḥu)
زَرَعُوا: they sowed (wrong after man — correct: zaraʿa)
حَصَدُوا: they reaped (wrong after man — correct: ḥaṣada)
تَذْكِرَتَانِ: two tickets (wrong as an object — correct: tadhkiratayni)
بِقَبْلِ: with before (wrong — correct: bi-qabūli, with acceptance)
الْفَائِقِ: the utmost (wrong in an iḍāfa — correct: fāʾiqi)
الضَّجِيجُ: the noise (wrong after a preposition — correct: aḍ-ḍajīji)
الطَّرِيقُ: the road, the way (wrong after anna — correct: aṭ-ṭarīqa)
أَهَمَّة: more important with a feminine ending (wrong — correct: ahammu)
نَجَحُوا: they passed (wrong here: a verb before its subject stays singular)
أُعْلِنَ: (it) was announced (m; wrong here: plurals of things take the feminine)
مِنِ: from (wrong vowel here: before al- it is mina)
أُسَجِّلُ: I enrol, register (indicative; wrong after an)
